title: MapSPAM 2020 V1r2 (SSA)
description: Crop production, harvested area, physical area and value-of-production rasters for sub-Saharan Africa, raw and Atlas-harmonised.

origin.license_note: CC-BY-4.0 verified 2026-10-08 from two independent sources: the CGSpace item 5736e3ff-aadc-4999-8922-8bac50b1c916 and the Harvard Dataverse API for doi:10.7910/DVN/Z0HK7R (license href creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/, v1.0, published 2026-01-07). This is the Alliance's MapSPAM2020_AdaptationAtlas_SSA, a DIFFERENT dataset from IFPRI's global SPAM2020 v2r2 that the CDH record `spam2020` describes and licenses CC-BY-SA-4.0. Plain attribution, no share-alike, so nothing propagates into the derived exposure or hazard_exposure products (#37).

transfer.rationale: On Atlas S3 already; every host fetches its own copy.

gaps: The processed tree is also an OUTPUT directory: R/0.4.0 writes variable=vop_intld15-2021/ and R/0.4.0 + R/0.4.2 write fao_prices/ into it, and R/0.4.4 lists it recursively for *.tif. Per-host file counts therefore differ with stage history (72 CGlabs / 48 macbook / 36 PASCAL, 2026-10-09). atlas_verify("mapspam-2020v1r2") separates the 48 origin objects from these extras (#58).

changelog.change: Record created from the existing metadata/data.json entry.
Acquisition recipe registered; this is now the only supported way to fetch it.
Added checksum manifest: 48 object(s), 1,332,962,700 bytes, verify=hash. Listed from the origin by R/checks/75_catalogue_manifest.R (headers only); R/00_acquire.R checks every download against it.

acquire.note: The processed/atlas-harmonized tree. The raw CSV tree is dataset mapspam-2020v1r2-raw.
